# Lab Alley

> Lab Alley is a US-based supplier of pure lab chemicals, solvents, and laboratory supplies with eco-friendly practices and guaranteed on-time delivery.

Lab Alley specializes in bulk chemical supply for laboratory, industrial, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic applications. The company offers multiple chemical grades (FCC, USP, ACS, HPLC, organic certified) and maintains an extensive product catalog with flexible ordering and custom pricing options.

## Key Topics

- Ethanol & Ethyl Alcohol
- Isopropyl Alcohol (Isopropanol)
- Hydrogen Peroxide
- Food Grade Chemicals
- FCC Certified
- USP Grade
- ACS Grade
- HPLC Grade
- Denatured & Undenatured
- Bulk Chemical Supplier
- Laboratory Solvents
- Organic Certified
- Disinfectants
- Industrial Chemicals
- Semiconductor Grade

- [Undenatured Ethyl Alcohol | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/non-denatured-ethanol): Certified organic, Kosher undenatured ethanol 140-200 proof from sugar cane

- [200 Proof Ethanol (100% Ethyl Alcohol) | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/ethanol-200-proof): Premium 200 proof ethanol, denatured and undenatured, bulk solvents
- [95% Ethanol (190 Proof Ethyl Alcohol) | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/ethanol-190-proof): 190 proof ethanol for DNA extraction, cleaning, chemical manufacturing
- [70% Ethanol (140 Proof Ethyl Alcohol) | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/ethanol-140-proof): 70% ethanol for histology, sterilization, RNA/DNA extraction
- [SD Alcohol | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/specially-denatured-ethanol-sda-3a): SDA 40-B alcohol 190-200 proof for cosmetics and pharmaceutical applications
- [Completely Denatured Alcohol (CDA) | Lab Alley](https://www.laballey.com/collections/buy-completely-denatured-alcohol-cda): CDA completely denatured ethanol for industrial solvents, cleaning, tax-exempt
